verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's official CLI has a documented `bw serve` mode that exposes the vault as a local RESTful Vault Management API. An agent can query it for TOTP codes and vault items, and it is described by its own OpenAPI document and Swagger UI. The official MCP server, which completed a live stdio handshake, adds a second local programmatic surface, so no screen-scraping is needed. missing for 10: a hands-on runtime query of the `bw serve` endpoint returning codes or secrets (the probe only verified that the CLI installs and prints its version).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can expose the vault through a local programmatic endpoint an agent can query for codes and secrets without screen-scraping the app

citations.quote: documented `bw serve` mode exposes the whole vault as a local RESTful API (Vault Management API) an agent can query for TOTP codes and items
The Vault Management API page embeds its own OpenAPI document for the CLI's `bw serve` local server.
The Bitwarden command-line interface (CLI) is a powerful, fully-featured tool for accessing and managing your vault.
